facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's HMIS Eswatini unit says a workshop in Piggs Peak tested and validated the integration of CMIS, the national EMR, with eLMIS, so that dispensing by a clinician in CMIS updates eLMIS stock automatically; it runs for ART medicines only and is ready for facility-level pilot ahead of national scale-up (workshop undated, published date used).

systems.owner: Ministry of Health (HMIS Eswatini unit), with Palladium and Vitalliance Corp
systems.tiers: not stated; clinicians dispense medication in it
not stated; facility-level pilot of the CMIS link planned
